title: Qualify a bounded research-plan compilation workflow
objective: The disabled planner has a concrete path to useful, evidence-bound enablement.
outcome: No invented dataset, field, join or analysis output can appear; insufficient evidence returns an incomplete plan. The same pinned selections produce the same plan; missing required sources remain a named gap. The eight existing tools continue working if planner activation is not accepted; no status text claims an enabled planner prematurely. Planner activation is not an incidental side effect of adding fields. An accepted plan compiles documented steps; it does not certify a study design. plan_research remains disabled. worker/index.mjs does not import enrichment. HTTP 200 is not a completed research task. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged.

commits.subject: Define planner acceptance and output scope
commits.instructions: Reuse existing planner interfaces to compile user-selected sources and documented contributions into a metadata plan. Preserve unresolved needs and explicit human access steps.
commits.verification: No invented dataset, field, join or analysis output can appear; insufficient evidence returns an incomplete plan.

commits.subject: Implement deterministic plan composition
commits.instructions: Assemble goal, sources, fields, access steps, qualified joins, limitations and citations from the accepted generation. Keep actual acquisition/analysis outside invocation.
commits.verification: The same pinned selections produce the same plan; missing required sources remain a named gap.

commits.subject: Prepare gated activation evidence
commits.instructions: Test positive finance/geography/pricing plans and forbidden assumptions, then prepare the exact capability/contract/UI change for Astra and owner review. Keep disabled until the relevant boundary is explicitly resolved.
commits.verification: The eight existing tools continue working if planner activation is not accepted; no status text claims an enabled planner prematurely.
